prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Review a watch battery-estimate gauge for a hiking app. Read interface.md. Audit the supplied interface; rank verified findings and show corrected behavior. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Use a framework-agnostic specification or pseudocode; do not assume an Apple SDK is available.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: watchOS. A hiking battery gauge has no concise title/description, no battery percentage unit, no endpoint labels, green as its only safety cue and displays unknown battery data as a real zero. No screenshot, sensor reading or runtime is provided.

criteria.task_completion: Identify and repair five explicit gauge-description, units, endpoint, noncolor and unknown-data defects with concrete current/range examples.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the gauges guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. Find five concrete semantic/honesty defects and provide clear range/current value, direction, unknown state, noncolor meaning and qualified estimate presentation.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task. Find five concrete semantic/honesty defects and provide clear range/current value, direction, unknown state, noncolor meaning and qualified estimate presentation.
criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
Recommends a topic-specific behavior contrary to the supplied source without explaining the scope and tradeoff.

required_findings.description: Gauge lacks a meaningful concise value description.
Current numerical value lacks percentage units.
Range endpoints are not meaningfully described.
Safety information relies on green alone.
Unknown data is represented as a genuine zero.

rubric.review_threshold: Find at least four of five seeded defects, including every critical defect; no invented high-severity finding.
